notes.title: Final stretch before release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're getting close to the official release on May 15, and we've just hit a major milestone: Chapter 3 is now complete. 🎉

This update also brings a good amount of visual and audio polish, as well as bug fixes and various improvements.

Thanks again to everyone following the project. We're almost there—see you very soon for the official release! 💙

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
Keyboard support is here !

Controller is no longer [b]required[/b] but still strongly advised.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
[b]Chapter 3 is almost coming to a close with the third stage now available ![/b]

Some stages have been reworked based on feedback from our testers.

Quality of Life Improvements:
[list]
[*] The back button now works on every screen.
[*] our updated leaderboard rank is displayed upon completing a stage
[*] The game automatically pauses when unplugging the controller or toggling the Steam overlay.
[/list]

notes.title: Map Updates, Fixes, and More
notes.notes:
Based on player feedback, some maps have received minor tweaks and fixes, while others have been fully revamped!

We've also fixed the energy boost.
